blocks.title: SAT / ACT / AP / IB
paragraphs: SAT/ACT required if selecting that route; optional as an additional route if using another accepted category. **No superscore**. Tests in person, validity 2 years and not expire before**1 August 2027**. Official electronic reports AND uploaded scans required. Codes in E. SAT total 1300–1350 exceeds 1240 minimum, **not** an official competitive grant threshold. Math-only admission minimum not separately published in these tables. AP standalone route not published here.

Last test permitted for financial support: SAT**5 December 2026**. NU says ACT**28 November 2026**, whereas [official ACT international schedule](https://www.act.org/content/dam/act/unsecured/documents/pdfs/Test-Date-Schedule-International-2026-2027.pdf) lists **23–24 October** and **11–12 December** around it, notNov 28. Therefore the safe existing international ACT opportunity before the stated limit is October, subject to seat availability; do not register for an imaginary November exam or assume December accepted. Score receipt deadline stillTBA.
